issues.reason: Thematic roles states outright that "a scalar-change subject rides Scalar change and is likewise Theme", and "declines" on the quantity-denoting subject "the moth-count" is the same change-of-value shape as the worked "the temperature fell" -> (Theme sk_fall_1 sk_temperature_1), so the specific scalar-change rule overrides the general intransitive change-of-state -> Patient test and (Patient sk_decline_1 sk_count_1) is the wrong role.

gaps_confirmed: No licensed carrier for a non-deictic, modifier-restricted season used as a temporal frame: During's outer slot is specified as a reified eventuality ('both reified'), the Time terms cover only Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic season constants (last_spring / next_summer), and Start/End take terms, so 'late autumn' has nowhere licensed to go and lands in the eventuality slot as a bare kind symbol.

The span sense of 'throughout' is not distinguished from the containment sense of 'during' - Intervals deliberately folds during / while / throughout onto one During head, so the parse's head choice is licensed but the totality reading (the decline holds across the whole period, not merely somewhere inside it) is unrecoverable.
new_gaps: A quantity / measure nominalization whose argument is incorporated as a noun premodifier ('the moth-count' = the count of moths) has no route to expose that argument: Compound concepts bars a genus atom for a noun modifier, and the object-incorporation rule exists only for agent-nominalizations (egg_layer -> (Lay egg_layer egg)), so 'the count of moths' yields (Of sk_count_1 moth) via Complements of nouns and adjectives while the compounded phrasing buries the same content in an opaque symbol - two phrasings of one fact producing non-comparable records.
defect_summary: The compliant form is (Theme sk_decline_1 sk_count_1) in place of the Patient atom - a licensed one-atom fix; every other atom in the parse stands as written.
notes: The prompt contradicts itself on this head - the obliques section says "During renders only the word 'during'" while Intervals licenses during / while / throughout alike - so the throughout -> During choice is licensed by the more specific rule and is not a defect. Unfiled minor: the witness is sk_count_1 where sk_<class>_<n> over the fused class moth_count gives sk_moth_count_1.
